$schema-note: Canonical source-of-truth for MCP servers in churn-graph. NOT read directly by any editor. The per-editor files (.cursor/mcp.json, .windsurf/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .mcp.json, .kiro/settings/mcp.json) are derived from this. Keep them in sync. See docs/mcp-setup.md.

context7._note: API key OPTIONAL (higher rate limits). Get one at context7.com/dashboard. Remote alternative: url https://mcp.context7.com/mcp + header Authorization: Bearer <key>.

playwright._note: Microsoft official. Add --headless or --isolated after the package arg if needed.

shadcn._note: shadcn/ui registry MCP. Reads components.json in project root. This is the 'Skill UI' server.
